fact.thing: CNYE's fall in 2026 through Sept 30, even though its current yield is listed at 51.72%
fact.box: Harvest Coinbase Enhanced High Income Shares ETF (TSX: CNYE)
fact.claim: Harvest's own CNYE page lists a current yield of 51.72% as of November 3, 2026. The same page shows the fund's performance for 2026 to date, as of September 30, as (13.75), a loss of 13.75%. The page doesn't say whether that figure uses the unit's net asset value or its market price, and the October drop is not included yet. The monthly payout is now $0.15 per unit, and a high yield can sit next to a shrinking investment when the unit price falls faster than the payouts come in.
